titleAr: فتح مساحة عمل Chat من غير متجر
titleEn: Create an Ebda Chat workspace without a Store

ar: ازاي افتح Ebda Chat من غير متجر؟
en: How do I start Ebda Chat without a store?

steps: Sign in with an Ebda account, enter the invite code and a workspace name, then open the inbox
edgeCases: While the flag is `invite`, creation needs an operator-minted single-use code; one owned workspace per person; the other methods on /workspaces are refused (person-level wildcard mount)
Standalone workspaces have no orders, catalogue, COD or recommendations
gaps: Self-serve (flag open) is not on yet; no self-service account deletion in Chat
assistantNote: creating a workspace needs an invite code while the flag is invite-only; hand off to Ebda for a code
